title: Spawners
tips: A spawner is a source: it pops out one item every few ticks, from the side its arrow points to.
Give that output somewhere to go — a conveyor into a storage or a seller — or it just backs up.
Each extra copy of the same spawner costs more than the last, so widen your line before you double up.

title: Conveyors
tips: A conveyor holds one item and shifts it one cell per tick, in the direction it faces.
Pick Rotate and tap a belt to turn it; chain them to route around anything.
If the far end is blocked the whole line jams and holds its items — nothing is ever lost.

title: Storage
tips: Storage stockpiles one item type — whatever arrives first locks it in until the crate is empty.
Pick Select and tap it to Sell All at the live market price; that also frees it for a new type.
It feeds the side it faces too, so it doubles as a buffer between two machines.

title: Sellers
tips: A seller instantly sells anything that reaches it, at the current market price. No tapping needed.
Sellers keep earning while you are away (up to 24 hours) — a storage just fills up and waits.
Prices drift, so check the Market panel to see what your line is actually worth right now.

title: Processors
tips: A processor turns one item into another: ore into a bar, wheat into bread.
It pulls input from directly behind it and pushes the result out of the front.
Chain them — ore → bar → ring is just two processors in a row.
No recipe for what arrives? You get worthless junk, so check the Recipe Book first.

title: Combiners
tips: A combiner fuses two items into one: a stick plus a bar makes an iron sword.
Feed the two sides either side of its output arrow; which input goes where does not matter.
Both slots must be full before it produces, so keep the two lines evenly fed.
An unknown pair becomes junk — the Recipe Book lists every valid combination.

title: Village Huts
tips: A Village Hut turns a food, a drink and a bed into a villager.
It has three inputs: food from behind, then the drink and the bed on its two flanks.
Each side accepts only its own ingredient, so if a line refuses to feed, swap the two flank lines.
Beds are planks plus wool, and water counts as a drink — no mines needed for any of it.

title: Town Halls
tips: A Town Hall banks villagers for good: route them in and they buff the whole factory.
Pick Select and tap the hall to see its population and exactly what it is boosting.
Specialists are the real prize — combine a villager with a ring, sword, bed, planks, wheat or ore.
Villagers only bank while you are playing; offline time never adds to the population.
